overview: This 133-page file brings together Japanese publicity plans for the United States, especially David Warren Ryder’s 1937–1938 proposals, with FBI and State Department inquiries into suspected espionage and political activity. Later records document payments from Japanese consular secret funds and a Soviet review of a book on espionage in America.
interest: Ryder’s detailed budgets and media plans can be compared with pamphlet results and later consular payment records.
